name: Ford - Michigan Assembly Plant, Wayne MI

fieldNotes.facility: Michigan Assembly Plant (Ford Ranger, Bronco), 38303 Michigan Ave, Wayne MI. Geocode landed on the rooftop (moved 170m); confirmed as the large assembly complex on the south side of Michigan Ave - ~5M sq ft of building on a 369-acre site (web-confirmed). Two large connected building clusters split by an active rail corridor.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Secured Ford assembly campus with perimeter fencing and wooded buffer along Michigan Ave. Controlled truck access driveways into the dock/yard areas; an internal vehicle-control gate (small canopy/booth structure with markings) controls movement between the plant and employee/finished-vehicle areas on the SW side.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Ford assembly plants run staffed security gatehouses at controlled entrances. Marked uncertain - the perimeter truck-gate booth could not be crisply isolated; the residential streets north of the plant prevent a clean Street View of the public-road truck gate.
fieldNotes.multiStep: Outer perimeter truck gate plus internal vehicle-control checkpoints typical of an assembly plant of this scale.
fieldNotes.railServed: Extensive rail yard with auto-rack rail cars loaded with finished vehicles running between the two building clusters along the south/center of the site.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Trailer drop rows visible along the rail corridor between the two buildings and on the east side - dozens of parked trailers separate from active dock staging.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 50+ trailers visible across the inter-building drop rows and dock faces.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Counted ~40 loading doors across the south building faces and dock aprons; estimate from overhead imagery - marked uncertain.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Distinct dock banks on the south face of the assembly building and the south stamping/integrated building - shipping and receiving run from physically separate clusters.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide multi-lane internal driveways and aprons with unused paved width for an express bypass.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Two large building complexes on one fenced property - the assembly plant and an integrated stamping building - a campus.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Inside the dense Detroit metro fabric in Wayne MI, surrounded by residential subdivisions and commercial corridors along Michigan Ave - Urban.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly identified; left uncertain.
